code: library(golemstockindices)  # the indices, and where each stands get_indices() all <- get_history(get_indices()$label, as.Date("1900-01-01")) overview_table(index_summary(all))  # one index since 2020: candlestick chart and monthly returns spx <- get_history("S&P 500", as.Date("2020-01-01")) plot_timeseries(spx) plot_returns_calendar(monthly_returns(spx), "S&P 500", mode = "dark")  # the whole history of the S&P 500, since 1927 spx <- get_history("S&P 500", as.Date("1900-01-01"))  # are some days, months or years of the presidential cycle better than others? seasons <- seasonality_analysis(spx, "year") seasonality_text(seasons) plot_seasonality(seasons)  # is the recent volatility normal? (needs more than a year of history) analysis <- volatility_analysis(spx) volatility_text(analysis) analysis$forecast$days   # the 95% range of the next 5 closes plot_volatility(analysis)  # how far below its all-time high, against its earlier falls falls <- drawdown_analysis(spx) drawdown_text(falls) plot_drawdowns(falls)  # several indices over the last year, starting at 100 history <- get_history(c("S&P 500", "Euro Stoxx 50", "Nikkei 225")) plot_compare(normalize_prices(history))
